The '''Kingdom of Congrave''' was a predecessor state of [[Solara]] centered on or associated with [[Congrave]].

== Role In Unification ==

During the [[Solaran War of Unification]], the Kingdom of Congrave joined the [[Grand Duchy of Solan]] against the [[Kingdom of Albion]]. The coalition defeated Albion in early 1538 and founded Solara.

Congrave's importance did not end with the kingdom's absorption. The city became the capital of the new Solaran state, making the kingdom one of the clearest institutional ancestors of modern Solaran government.

== Open Canon ==

The source does not explain whether the Kingdom of Congrave's royal house survived as ceremonial nobility, was dissolved, or helped design the first parliamentary constitution. Those questions should be left open until more source material or user canon clarifies them.
